dedupe_keys.name: daypsci v1 event based dataset of fault injection scenarios in a plc controlled industrial cyber physical system

description: DAYPSCI v1 holds time-series data from an industrial cyber-physical system, a PLC-controlled part marking station using Siemens S7-1200 and S7-1500 devices. The Universidad de Burgos repository page says data are logged per event, recording changes in system variables with their duration, PLC scan-cycle identifiers and event order, for normal operation and for controlled fault injection on sensors and actuators such as solenoid valves, with ground truth labels taken from the experiment configuration. Each experimental batch has processed event data in CSV, raw network captures in PCAPNG including PROFINET traffic, and documentation. It was published in May 2026 by Juan V. Martín-Fraile, Nuño Basurto, Jesús Enrique Sierra García and Álvaro Herrero as one zip of about 1.48 GB with a readme, free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one laboratory station. Caveats: faults are injected, not observed, and the number of batches is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives labelled fault sequences at PLC scan level to train anomaly detection and to parameterise discrete-event digital twins of production cells. Related catalogue records include the battery manufacturing ICS data and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework manufacturing testbed datasets.
